existing_ci.scope: Existing Python tests, route benchmark and lint; not native Unreal

reference_data.overlay_pose_source: simulation telemetry, not satellite detection or SLAM

review_findings.finding: Idle/terminal returns precede pose ingestion; continuous observation required.
JSON/network reply under control lock; static slow-client latency risk, not a measured incident.
Missing mission identity, fixed start, actual trail, plan history and exposed progress.
GNC 5001 camera link is separate from ROS-free 8766; single camera authority required.
8 m perspective top view and active rover camera are not orbital imagery or a raw navcam feed.
World-build material modes must not be used for live view switching; sensor RGB would change.
No native screen picking or browser live-camera endpoint in current 2D mission UI.
Wire commands are not measured wheel RPM; battery/current/temperature channels are unestablished.
Export actual center RGB id and calibration before serving the display stream.
Editor-only camera requires runtime integration for packaged interaction.

planned_phases.name: Continuous mission observation, trail and bounded snapshots
Single-owner native camera rig and transitions
Map/native view goal preview and picking
Sensor frame display and adaptive view quality

invariants: View switches preserve mission id, goal, Play session and sensor configuration
Actual trail derives from telemetry, not planned waypoints
Archived imagery and live simulation overlays are separately labelled
Unavailable telemetry channels are never fabricated
Native world picking and sensor-derived picking remain distinct
Old-session and mismatched-map goals cannot execute
Encoding/network/disk work cannot hold the control lock
optional_later: Cesium Mars context with verified horizontal and vertical reference transforms
Pixel Streaming for unified browser Unreal video and input
excluded_current_phase: User CAD and real motor calibration
Live MRO video or flight-qualified autonomy
